question: In Los Angeles how many schools have more than 500 free meals but less than 700 free or reduced price meals for K-12?

candidates.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode) AS SchoolCount
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
  AND T2.City = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700 
  AND `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT COUNT(*) AS SchoolCount
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS TotalSchools
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS SchoolCount
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) 
FROM schools AS T1

question: Which school in Contra Costa has the highest number of test takers?

candidates.sql:
SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY ss.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    ss.NumTstTakr AS TestTakers
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.County = 'contra costa'
ORDER BY 
    ss.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    ss.NumTstTakr AS TotalTestTakers
FROM 
    satscores ss
JOIN 
    schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY 
    ss.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    SUM(ss.NumTstTakr) AS TotalTestTakers
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.County = 'contra costa county'
GROUP BY 
    s.School
ORDER BY 
    TotalTestTakers DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY SUM(ss.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScoreInWriting,
    s.Phone AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN

WHERE

GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone

SELECT 
    sch.Phone
FROM 
    schools sch

GROUP BY 
    sch.Phone
ORDER BY 
    AVG(sat.AvgScrRead) ASC
LIMIT 1

question: What is the ratio in percentage of Santa Clara County schools that are locally funded compared to all other types of charter school funding?
evidence: Ratio in percentage = (count(locally funded schools in Santa Clara) / count(all funding type schools in Santa Clara) * 100%

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Local' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 
     CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FundingType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL)) * 100 AS LocalFundingRatio
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN frpm."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(frpm."CDSCode")) AS Ratio
FROM 
    frpm
INNER JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."Charter Funding Type")) AS Ratio
FROM 
    frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T2.County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.County = 'Santa Clara' AND T1."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
   SUM(CASE WHEN T2.County = 'Santa Clara' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS RatioInPercentage
FROM 
  frpm T1
  INNER JOIN schools T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 1 AND T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS Ratio
FROM 
    satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T2.County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType <> 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS Ratio
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County = 'Santa Clara' AND Charter = 1

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.County = 'Santa Clara' AND T1.FundingType = 'Local' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T1.County = 'Santa Clara' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS Ratio
FROM 
    schools T1
JOIN 
    frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

WITH SantaClaraSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        FundingType
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Santa Clara'
        AND Charter = 1
),
LocallyFundedCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS LocallyFundedCount
    FROM 
        SantaClaraSchools
    WHERE 
        FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
),
TotalCharterCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS TotalCharterCount
    FROM 
        SantaClaraSchools
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(LocallyFundedCount AS REAL) / TotalCharterCount) * 100 AS Ratio
FROM 
    LocallyFundedCount, TotalCharterCount

question: Among the accounts who have loan validity more than 12 months, list out the accounts that have the highest approved amount and have account opening date in 1993.
evidence: Loan validity more than 12 months refers to duration > 12

candidates.sql:
SELECT l.account_id, MAX(l.amount) AS highest_approved_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
GROUP BY l.account_id
ORDER BY highest_approved_amount DESC

SELECT T2.*
FROM loan AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '1993'
  AND T1.amount = (
    SELECT MAX(amount)
    FROM loan
    WHERE duration > 12
  )

SELECT 
    account_id, 
    MAX(amount) AS max_amount
FROM 
    loan
WHERE 
    duration > 12
    AND account_id IN (
        SELECT 
            account_id
        FROM 
            account
        WHERE 
            STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1993'
    )
GROUP BY 
    account_id

WITH FilteredLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id,
        l.amount AS approved_amount
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE 
        l.duration > 12
        AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31'
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        approved_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        FilteredLoans
)
SELECT 
    account_id
FROM 
    RankedLoans
WHERE 
    rn = 1

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date LIKE '1993-%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM account
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1993'
),
filtered_loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, amount
  FROM loan
  WHERE duration > 12
)
SELECT T1.account_id, T1.amount
FROM filtered_loans AS T1
INNER JOIN filtered_accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.amount = (
  SELECT MAX(amount)
  FROM filtered_loans
)

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What was the growth rate of the total amount of loans across all accounts for a male client between 1996 and 1997?
evidence: Growth rate = (sum of amount_1997 - sum of amount_1996) / (sum of amount_1996) * 100%; Male refers to gender = 'M'

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE 
    T3.gender = 'M'

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan l
INNER JOIN 
    disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M'
    AND l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M' 
    AND l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

WITH loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_1997
    FROM loan l
    INNER JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
)

FROM loan_amounts

    disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id

    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'deposit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debt,
    l.status AS loan_status
FROM 
    client c
INNER JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY 
    l.status

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'deposit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debt,
    l.status AS payment_status
FROM 
    client c
INNER JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY 
    l.status

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VKLAD' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_payments
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 992

    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'deposit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debt,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'payment' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS payments
FROM 
    trans t
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE 
    d.client_id = 992

SELECT 
  l.amount AS total_debt,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) >= l.amount THEN 'paid off'
    ELSE 'in debt'
  END AS payment_status
FROM 
  loan l
  INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
  c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY 
  l.amount

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount - l.payments ELSE 0 END) AS debt_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loan_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.payments ELSE 0 END) AS total_payments_made,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'Fully Paid'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.payments ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Overdue'
    ELSE 'Current'
  END AS payment_status
FROM 
  client c
  INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  INNER JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
  c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY 
  c.client_id

  SUM(l.amount) AS total_debt,

     ELSE 'Not Paid'
   END) AS payment_status
FROM 
  loan l
INNER JOIN 
  disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE 
  d.client_id = 992

    l.amount AS debt_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Fully Paid'
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'In Progress'
        WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS payment_status

    loan l
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE 
    d.client_id = 992

  c.id AS card_id,
  c.name AS card_name,

  CASE 
    WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'The card has missing or degraded properties and values.'

FROM 
  cards c

  rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE 
  c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

SELECT T2.name
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.code
WHERE T2.language = 'Russian'
GROUP BY T2.name
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.name
FROM sets AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode
WHERE T2.language = 'Russian'
ORDER BY T1.baseSetSize DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
WHERE s.baseSetSize = (
    SELECT MAX(baseSetSize)
    FROM sets
)
AND s.language = 'Russian'

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.setCode = st.setCode
WHERE st.language = 'Russian' AND s.baseSetSize = (
    SELECT MAX(baseSetSize)
    FROM sets
    WHERE setCode IN (
        SELECT setCode
        FROM set_translations
        WHERE language = 'Russian'
    )
)

SELECT T2.name
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.code
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid
WHERE T3.language = 'Russian'
GROUP BY T2.name
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT name

ORDER BY baseSetSize DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.multiverseid = st.id
WHERE fd.language = 'Russian'
ORDER BY s.baseSetSize DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
GROUP BY f.language

SELECT 
  AVG(set_count) AS average_sets,
  language
FROM (
  SELECT 
    fd.language,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.setCode) AS set_count
  FROM 
    foreign_data fd
  INNER JOIN 
    cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE 
    c.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  GROUP BY 
    fd.language
)
GROUP BY 
  language

WITH AnnualSetCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS releaseYear,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS setCount
    FROM 
        sets s
    JOIN 
        cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
    JOIN 
        foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
    WHERE 
        s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'

),
CommonLanguage AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.language,
        COUNT(fd.language) AS languageCount
    FROM 
        foreign_data fd

    ORDER BY 
        languageCount DESC

question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
evidence: user no. 24 refers to UserId = OwnerUserId = '24'; times of his/her post than votes = Divide (Count(post.Id), Count(votes.Id))

candidates.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.Id) AS TimesPostsThanVotes
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.OwnerUserId = v.UserId
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = 24

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.OwnerUserId = 24 THEN p.Id END) AS REAL) / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.UserId = 24 THEN v.Id END) AS TimesPostsThanVotes
FROM 
    posts p
LEFT JOIN 
    votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE 
    p.OwnerUserId = 24 OR v.UserId = 24

SELECT CAST(COUNT(p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.Id) AS Ratio
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = 24 AND p.PostTypeId = 1

SELECT 
    COUNT(p.Id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(v.Id), 0) AS Ratio
FROM 
    posts p
LEFT JOIN 
    votes v ON p.OwnerUserId = v.UserId
WHERE 
    p.OwnerUserId = 24 AND v.UserId = 24

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.OwnerUserId = 24 THEN p.Id END) * 1.0 / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.UserId = 24 THEN v.Id END) AS Times
FROM 
    posts p
LEFT JOIN 
    votes v ON p.OwnerUserId = v.UserId
WHERE 
    p.OwnerUserId = 24
    OR v.UserId = 24

SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.Id) AS RatioOfPostsToVotes
FROM 
  posts p
  LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.OwnerUserId = v.UserId
WHERE 
  p.OwnerUserId = 24

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.Id) AS times
FROM 
    posts p
LEFT JOIN 
    votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE 
    p.OwnerUserId = 24

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.Id) AS TimesOfPostsThanVotes
FROM 
    posts p
LEFT JOIN 
    votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE 
    p.OwnerUserId = 24

question: Calculate the average view count of posts tagged as 'humor' and write the title and the comments of the posts alongside their scores if applicable.
evidence: "humor" is the Tags; comment of the post refers to Text; average view count = AVG(ViewCount)

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(T1.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount,
  T1.Title,
  T2.Text AS Comment,
  T2.Score AS CommentScore
FROM 
  posts T1
  LEFT JOIN comments T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId
WHERE 
  T1.Tags LIKE '%humor%' 
  AND T2.Text IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  T1.Title, T2.Text, T2.Score

question: What are the names of badges that users who have the highest reputation obtained?
evidence: highest reputation refers to Max(Reputation); user refers to UserId

candidates.sql:
SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
INNER JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
WHERE b.UserId IN (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.Reputation = (
        SELECT MAX(Reputation)
        FROM users
    )
)

SELECT T2.Name
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId
WHERE T1.Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users )

question: What is the name of tags used by John Stauffer's?
evidence: DisplayName = 'John Stauffer';

candidates.sql:
SELECT T1.Name
FROM tags AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Name = T2.Tags
INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T2.OwnerUserId = T3.Id
WHERE T3.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN tags t ON p.Tags LIKE '%' || t.TagName || '%'
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.TagName
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.Tags LIKE '%' || T2.TagName || '%'
INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T3.Id
WHERE T3.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

SELECT DISTINCT T.TagName
FROM posts P
JOIN tags T ON P.Tags LIKE '%' || T.TagName || '%'
JOIN users U ON P.OwnerUserId = U.Id
WHERE U.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.TagName
FROM tags AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Tags
INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T2.OwnerUserId = T3.Id
WHERE T3.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.TagName
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T3.Id
INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON ',' || T1.Tags || ',' LIKE '%,' || T2.TagName || ',%'
WHERE T3.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.TagName
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.OwnerUserId
INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON T3.Tags LIKE '%' || T2.TagName || '%'
WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer'

evidence: SUBTRACT(SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Mornington'), SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Amos'));

    (SELECT SUM(p.ViewCount) 
     FROM posts p
     JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
     WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mornington') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(p.ViewCount) 
     FROM posts p
     JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
     WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Amos') AS ViewCountDifference

  (SELECT SUM(ViewCount) 
   FROM posts 
   WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Mornington')) -
  (SELECT SUM(ViewCount)

INNER JOIN 
    users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE CreationDate = (SELECT MAX(CreationDate) FROM users)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM LatestUser)) AS PostCount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM LatestUser)) AS CommentCount

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = u.Id) AS Posts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE UserId = u.Id) AS Comments
FROM 
  users u
WHERE 
  u.CreationDate = (SELECT MAX(CreationDate) FROM users)

LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE u.CreationDate = (SELECT MAX(CreationDate) FROM users)

    COUNT(p.Id) AS post_count, 
    COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count

    users u

    u.CreationDate = (SELECT MAX(CreationDate) FROM users)

  COUNT(p.Id) AS Count

  p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY CreationDate DESC LIMIT 1)

question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
evidence: The user with higher reputation has more influence; DIVIDE(COUNT(stats_posts.Id where Score > = 50 and MAX(Reputation))), COUNT(stats_posts.Id where MAX(Reputation)) as percentage;

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage_high_score_posts
FROM 
    posts p
JOIN 
    users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE 
    u.Id = (
        SELECT OwnerUserId
        FROM posts
        JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
        ORDER BY users.Reputation DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Score >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM 
    posts p
JOIN 
    users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE 
    u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)

WITH most_influential_user AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_influential_user_posts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_posts
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM most_influential_user)
),
high_score_posts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_score_count
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM most_influential_user)
      AND Score >= 50
)

FROM high_score_posts, most_influential_user_posts

  superhero AS T1

GROUP BY s.id

    superhero s

SELECT T2.team_short_name
FROM Match AS T1
INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.home_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.season = '2015/2016' AND T1.home_team_goal < T1.away_team_goal
GROUP BY T2.team_short_name
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    t.team_long_name AS away_team_name
FROM 
    Match m
JOIN 
    Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN 
    League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE 
    l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
    AND m.season = '2009/2010'
    AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY 
    t.team_long_name

  FROM 
    Player p

  GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
),
HeightRankCTE AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    p.height,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.height DESC) AS height_rank_desc,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.height ASC) AS height_rank_asc

)
SELECT

question: How many patients hadn't undergone a medical examination until at least a year following their initial hospital visit?
evidence: hadn't undergone a medical examination until at least a year refers to SUBTRACT(year(`Examination Date`), year(`First Date`)) > = 1

candidates.sql:
SELECT COUNT(P.ID) AS PatientCount
FROM Patient P
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination E
    WHERE E.ID = P.ID
    AND strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) >= 1
)

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) AS PatientCount
FROM Patient AS T1
LEFT JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` IS NULL OR julianday(T2.`Examination Date`) - julianday(T1.`First Date`) < 365

SELECT COUNT(P.ID) AS count
FROM Patient P
LEFT JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.ID IS NULL OR JULIANDAY(E.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(P.`First Date`) < 365

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS NoExamCount
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.ID IS NULL OR e.`Examination Date` < p.`First Date` OR e.`Examination Date` > DATE(p.`First Date`, '+1 year')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
LEFT JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` IS NULL OR E.`Examination Date` < DATE(P.`First Date`, '+1 year')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE julianday(e.`Examination Date`) - julianday(p.`First Date`) > 365
OR e.ID IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) >= 365

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_patients
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID AND strftime('%J', e.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%J', p.`First Date`) <= 365
WHERE e.ID IS NULL

    SELECT SUM(L.`T-CHO`) AS NovCholesterol
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

),

    SELECT SUM(L.`T-CHO`) AS DecCholesterol
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

  (COUNT(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 END)) AS Percentage
FROM 
  Patient P
JOIN 
  Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
  strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) > 55
  AND L.PT >= 14

WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) > 55

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS FemalePercentageWithAbnormalPT
